profile.headline: Engineer at Intel and B.S. in Computer Engineering Graduate from University of Florida

positions.title: EDA Tools Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained a large git repository consisting of several in-house developed software tools, was owner of two of said tools. Spearheaded the migration of the main repository from TeamForge to Github, allowing for better and easier collaboration
• Released nightly and weekly versions of the tool via automated scripts
• Drove the release of countless tool override files by conducting thorough end-to-end testing and debugging any failures. Delivered said files to in-house customers wishing to try new tool contours and Product Development Kits to assess impact.

positions.title: CAD Intern
positions.description:
• Created a comprehensive list of variable names, their flow function, and settings for easy to access team reference
• Experimented with a new synthesis tool the company was trying to incorporate on a larger scale by analyzing and testing possible benefits
• Gained experience in using a formal equivalence verification tool and an understanding of the SoC design process

positions.title: Internal Vice President
positions.description:
UF DSI is a student organization at the University of Florida dedicated to promoting data science. We are partnered with the UF Informatics Institute whose aim is to foster informatics research and education at UF. We deliver workshops on key tools used in data science such as Python, R, SQL and other software and statistics concepts, host speakers from within UF on topics related to data science, and connect students to resources and events available through the Informatics Institute. 

• Elected Internal Vice President of the UF Data Science and Informatics student organization for the 2017-18 school year
• As IVP, I managed an internal board of 8 students, including Workshop Coordinators, Kaggle Coordinators, and Social Coordinators, and oversee creation and delivery of workshops, Kaggle groups, and club social events
• Was an instructor for workshops on an introduction to data science, data visualization, and an introduction to machine learning in Python

positions.title: Technical Staff Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Part of the Platform Engineering Group (PEG)
• Wrote a TCL script to automate process for sending synthesis or automatic place and route tool test cases to a third-party company by translating existing wiki documentation into said script
• Helped drive execution of testcase creation utilizing the script I developed, greatly speeding up testcase production
• Completed training in tool command language (TCL) and learned usage of synthesis and automatic place and route tools

positions.title: IT Programmer Analyst Intern
positions.description:

• Information Management (IM) department

honors.title: Thomas O. Hunter Leadership Scholarship Endowment
honors.description:
The Thomas O. Hunter Leadership Scholarships are annually awarded to engineering undergraduate or graduate student leaders. 
Criteria:
• Minimum 2 years of University leadership experience in the Herbert Wertheim College of Engineering or otherwise (office or executive board of a student society, student group, student council, student government).
• Demonstrated dedication to the community around them (i.e. peer advisor, campus tour leader, volunteer, etc.).
• Dedication and commitment to leadership (i.e. years of service, increasing levels of responsibility, state/regional/national exposure)
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Florida Herbert Wertheim College of Engineering · Sep 2018

honors.title: University of Florida College of Engineering Dean's List
honors.description:
3.20 GPA with a minimum of 14 credits in the semester.
Achieved for the following semesters: Spring 2015, Fall 2015, Spring 2016, Spring 2018
honors.issuer: Issued by Herbert Wertheim College of Engineering at the University of Florida · Apr 2018

volunteerExperiences.description:
Volunteered over 150 hours in the summers of 2012, 2013, and 2015 at St. Mary's Medical Center in West Palm Beach, FL

Worked on the nursing floor:
• Assisted nurses on the floor while caring for patients
• Answered phone and patient buzzer when patients needed assistance
• Brought food and drinks to patients when asked
Worked in ICU/Surgery Recovery:
• Transferred beds and other materials between floors
• Assisted nurses in moving patients to their room post-surgery
• Assembled oxygen waters & stocked recovery supplies
• Logged patient information in book (Arrival date/time, doctor, procedure done, etc.)
